watch_tab: Open watch screen in a new tab
setup_help: Map four existing categories to streams. Empty choices stay hidden. Feeds are managed by FreshRSS. Disable other layout extensions on these categories to avoid conflicts.
deduplicate: Group similar news on loaded pages
interested: Priority phrases that override unwanted phrases, comma-separated
reader_help: Public HTML only. Reader hosts must be explicitly allowed, including redirect hosts. No subscription cookies, private networks or automatic video downloads. Retrieval is on demand, cached for 24 hours.
not_found: Article not found in configured streams.
restricted: This page is subscriber-only. The feed summary is preserved.
host_not_allowed: Allow this source hostname in extension settings before retrieving it.
no_content: No readable article found. Adjust the article XPath for this source.
too_large: The source response is too large.
fetch_failed: The source could not be retrieved. The feed content is preserved.
unsafe_url: Only allowed public HTTPS pages can be retrieved.
download_url: Optional MeTube URL (requires CORS or a same-origin reverse proxy)
download_failed: Unable to queue download. Check MeTube and CORS settings.
